# Xinyuehong - Self-Service Kiosk Terminals and Industrial PCs

> Shenzhen Xinyuehong Information Technology Co., Ltd. designs and builds self-service kiosk terminals and the industrial computers inside them. Product range: floor-standing and wall-mounted terminals for ordering, payment, check-in, ticketing and information; fanless box PCs, panel PCs, wall-mount panels and Android boards. OEM/ODM covers cabinet redesign, module integration and small-batch production. Reference builds are documented per model; every configuration is confirmed in writing per project.

## Company facts

- Legal entity: Shenzhen Xinyuehong Information Technology Co., Ltd.
- Location: No. 38 Tian'an Road, Bantian, Longgang, Shenzhen, China
- Manufacturing: self-service kiosk terminals, industrial PCs, embedded boards
- Engagement model: OEM and ODM, one-unit minimum order quantity, 15-day reference lead time
- Website: https://xinyuehongtech.com/ | Email: sales@xinyuehongtech.com | WhatsApp: +86 139 2749 8231

## Industries

- [Airport Self Check-in Kiosks & Bag Tag Printing](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/airport-aviation/): Airport self check-in kiosks with passport capture, boarding pass and bag tag printing, and multi-language interfaces for departures halls.
- [Bank Self-Service Kiosks & Branch Terminals](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/banking/): Self-service kiosks for bank branches: account enquiry, statement printing, card issue and cash handling, with encrypting PIN pads and privacy surrounds.
- [Ticketing & Entertainment Kiosks for Venues](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/entertainment-ticketing/): Ticket vending and collection kiosks for cinemas, attractions and stadiums: QR redemption, thermal printing and contactless payment.
- [Government & Municipal Self-Service Kiosks](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/government/): Self-service terminals for government halls, social security and immigration counters, with document readers and certificate printing.
- [Hospital Self-Service Kiosks & Payment Terminals](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/hospital/): Self-service kiosks for hospital registration, payment, queue tickets and medical record printing, with card readers, A4 printers and patient-facing flows.
- [Hotel Self Check-in Kiosks & Key Card Dispensing](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/hotels/): Hotel self check-in kiosks with passport and ID reading, key card dispensing and PMS integration for lobbies, aparthotels and residences.
- [Parking Payment & Transport Kiosks](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/parking-transport/): Parking payment terminals for kerbside and lane-side sites: QR and card payment, ticket printing and weather-resistant enclosures.
- [QSR Self-Ordering Kiosks for Fast Food & Fast Casual](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/qsr-restaurants/): Self-ordering kiosks for quick-service restaurants: 21.5-32 inch touchscreens, EMV terminal brackets, 80 mm printers and floor or counter builds.
- [Retail Self-Checkout & Self-Service Kiosks](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industries/retail/): Retail self-checkout kiosks with 2D scan decks, EMV mounting, receipt printing and camera provisions for staffed or unattended lanes.

- [Self-Payment Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/self-payment-kiosk/): Payment-ready self-service kiosks with scanner, printer and third-party payment device mounting, for retail, parking, healthcare and public service.

- [Ticketing Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/ticketing-kiosk/): Ticket issuing and queue management kiosks for transport halls, attractions and service centres, with ticket printers, QR scanners and card payment.

- [Wall-Mounted Kiosks | OEM/ODM Kiosk Solutions](https://xinyuehongtech.com/products/wall-mounted-kiosk/): Wall-mounted touchscreen kiosks for corridors, lift lobbies and counters where floor space is limited, with card readers, printers and VESA mounting.

## Self-service terminal models

- [Bank Self-Service Kiosk with PIN Pad](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/bank-self-service-kiosk/): A vertical touchscreen organised around three service tiles: account services, payment and enquiry, with the PIN pad, card readers and printer grouped on the lower panel.
- [Border Inspection Service Island](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/border-inspection-service-island/): A service island for port and land-crossing checkpoints: guidance display above, working touchscreen below, four reader slots, keyboard and contactless pad over a high-capacity cabinet.
- [Clinic Self-Service Terminal with Card Dispenser](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/clinic-card-dispenser-kiosk/): A clinic terminal that handles registration, payment, report printing and record printing, with a card dispenser built into the base.
- [Tilted Countertop Touch Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/countertop-touch-kiosk/): A compact angled touchscreen for countertops and reception desks, available in light and dark finishes, suited to queries and quick check-in.
- [Dual-Screen Government Affairs Terminal](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/dual-screen-government-affairs-terminal/): A large public-office unit pairing a top advertising display with a working touchscreen and a full reader set for identity-heavy procedures.
- [Exit-Entry & Immigration Self-Service Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/exit-entry-immigration-kiosk/): A two-screen configuration for exit-entry and immigration halls: announcements and queue status above, permit application, payment and document collection below, over a high-capacity service cabinet.
- [Financial Self-Service Terminal (ATM Style)](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/financial-self-service-terminal/): A recessed-screen enclosure with keypad, card slots and a reinforced service cabinet, laid out for banking-style cash and card procedures.
- [Vertical Touchscreen Ticketing Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/floor-standing-ticketing-kiosk/): A floor-standing terminal that puts a vertical touchscreen, ticket printer, QR scanner and contactless reader into one cabinet for queue and ticket counters.
- [Government Services Kiosk with Document Readers](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/government-services-card-reader-kiosk/): A Windows-based service counter built around document and card reading: ID documents, social-security cards, bank cards and printed receipts in one session.
- [Hospital Registration & Payment Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/hospital-registration-payment-kiosk/): A hospital front-desk terminal that separates guidance content on the upper display from registration and payment work on the touchscreen below.
- [Medical Insurance Service Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/medical-insurance-service-kiosk/): A curved vertical display with insurance service tiles over a deck holding the card readers, printer and scanning module.
- [Medical Record Printing Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/medical-record-printing-kiosk/): A counter-height enclosure dedicated to medical record self-service: identity verification, then release and print of the requested document.
- [Mobile Hospital Self-Service Station](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/mobile-hospital-self-service-station/): A tall service station on casters with a side identification column, both self-service and assisted flows, plus lockable storage for consumables.
- [32-Inch Multi-Industry Self-Service Terminal](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/multi-industry-self-service-terminal/): A 32-inch 2560 × 1440 portrait display above a glass deck, with 1D/2D scanning, IC/ID and bank card reading and a receipt printer in the side column. One cabinet for five counter types.
- [Parking Payment Terminal](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/parking-payment-terminal/): A slim dark-cabinet terminal with a vertical display above an angled payment deck, laid out for card, code and receipt handling in car parks.
- [Slim Social Security Services Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/slim-social-security-kiosk/): An ultra-slim body that still carries the full social-security module set: card slot, ID scanner, keyboard, QR reader and receipt printer.
- [Sloped Touch Information Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/sloped-touch-information-kiosk/): A horizontal touchscreen set into a curved enclosure, aimed at directories, wayfinding and self-service lookup in public buildings.
- [Ticket Vending & Collection Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/ticket-vending-collection-kiosk/): A slim unit for both ticket purchase and collection, with a QR and contactless panel above the ticket outlet at reachable height.
- [Wall-Mounted Hospital Payment Terminal](https://xinyuehongtech.com/self-service-terminals/wall-mounted-hospital-payment-terminal/): A wall-mounted unit that compresses registration, payment and printing hardware into a shallow cabinet for corridors, lift lobbies and nurse stations.

## Industrial PCs and boards

- [Fanless Embedded Box PC | Industrial Computers](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industrial-pc/fanless-box-pc/): Rugged fanless embedded box PC for 24/7 kiosk and HMI integration: Intel Celeron J6412 with Core i3/i5 options, triple Gigabit LAN, four USB 3.0 ports, HDMI and three DisplayPort outputs, two removable drive.
- [Android Embedded Board | Industrial Computers](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industrial-pc/industrial-motherboard/): Rockchip RK3568 / RK3399 Android embedded board for kiosks and digital signage: LVDS, eDP and HDMI display outputs, multi-channel UART and GPIO headers, USB, RJ45 and an SDK for OS-level customisation.
- [Industrial Panel PC | Industrial Computers](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industrial-pc/industrial-panel-pc/): Industrial touch panel PC with 10-point PCAP glass and a die-cast aluminium housing: IP65 front-panel option, panel-mount or VESA installation, for factory HMI, control cabinets and semi-outdoor terminals.
- [Wall-Mount Touch Panel | Industrial Computers](https://xinyuehongtech.com/industrial-pc/wall-mount-touch-panel/): Slim wall-mount touch terminal in Windows or Android builds: narrow bezel, rear cable entry and a VESA or X-braced wall bracket, for meeting-room booking, bedside enquiry and interactive wayfinding.

## Guides and articles

- [Floor-Standing vs Wall-Mounted Kiosks](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/floor-standing-vs-wall-mounted-kiosks/): Quick answer: Compare kiosk installation styles by footprint, viewing height, serviceability, peripherals and customer traffic patterns.
- [Hotel Check-in Kiosk Hardware: Peripherals and Enclosure](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/hotel-kiosk-peripherals-enclosure/): Quick answer: Four peripherals decide a hotel check-in build — passport or ID reader, key card dispenser with a lock-vendor encoder, camera and receipt printer — plus a mounted payment terminal.
- [How to Choose a Self-Service Kiosk](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/how-to-choose-a-self-service-kiosk/): Quick answer: A practical method for defining kiosk application, display, peripherals, operating system and deployment conditions before requesting a quotation.
- [Kiosk ADA Height, IP65 and IK Ratings Explained](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/kiosk-ada-ip-ik-ratings/): Quick answer: On a public self-service terminal the reach range is 15 to 48 inches above finished floor (ADA 308/309), the usual ingress protection is IP54 indoors and IP65 where the unit is washed or rained.
- [EMV Terminal Integration and Kiosk OS Choice](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/kiosk-payment-integration-os/): Quick answer: Mount the terminal on the cabinet rather than building payment into it. The terminal keeps its own PCI PTS and scheme approval.
- [Why Self-Service Kiosks Fail in 24/7 Operation](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/kiosk-thermal-design-24-7-reliability/): Quick answer: Most kiosk downtime traces back to heat, not software. Thermal design, fanless industrial PCs and component derating keep terminals running around the clock.
- [Kiosk Touchscreen Technologies Compared](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/kiosk-touchscreen-technology-comparison/): Quick answer: PCAP, infrared and SAW touchscreens behave differently behind glass, in rain, with gloves and after vandalism. A practical comparison for kiosk buyers.
- [OEM/ODM Self-Service Kiosk Project Checklist](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/oem-odm-self-service-kiosk-project-checklist/): Quick answer: What to prepare for an OEM or ODM kiosk RFQ, including cabinet design, modules, software, certifications, test samples and project milestones.
- [How Much Does a Self-Service Kiosk Cost? 2026 Price Guide](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/self-service-kiosk-cost/): Quick answer: A basic countertop self-service kiosk costs US$380–700 FOB Shenzhen. A 27–32-inch floor-standing kiosk with card readers, scanner and receipt printer runs US$1,300–2,600.
- [Self-Service Kiosk Modules: What to Specify](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/self-service-kiosk-modules-guide/): Quick answer: Almost every self-service kiosk is assembled from the same eight module families — display and touch, computing platform, card and identity readers, barcode and QR scanners, printers, payment and.

- [EU Cyber Resilience Act: Reporting Duties for Kiosk Builds](https://xinyuehongtech.com/news/eu-cra-kiosk-reporting/): Article 14 deadlines (24 h, 72 h, 14 days), what counts as a product with digital elements, and the six questions buyers now ask suppliers.

## What the datasheets contain

Each product datasheet is a two-page PDF with the technical specification, embedded modules, configuration options and typical applications: https://xinyuehongtech.com/downloads/

## Notes for retrieval

- Specifications describe the reference build; screen size, module mix, ratings and certification scope are confirmed per project.
- No prices are published. The cost guide explains the structure and gives 2026 reference ranges.
- Certification scope is per model and per market; compliance is confirmed in the quotation, not implied by the marketing copy.
